title: Soup Servings
goal: Compute the chance soup A empties first plus half the chance both soups empty together.
strategy: Scale volumes to 25 mL units. Each state averages the four equally likely serving outcomes; A-empty states score one, B-empty states zero, and simultaneous-empty states one half.
